messages:
ajay-singh: Drafted postmortem for last night's incident — routing oscillation caused 5xx spikes and cross-region retries. Root cause: intermittent SNI mismatch on a subset of LB frontends combined with aggressive per-route health checks. PM link: https://redwood.internal/pm/1768509123 (internal)

maria-guzman: reading it now. can you drop the key findings + high-priority action items here?

ajay-singh: sure — short list:
1) fix SNI fallback path in frontends (likely nginx/haproxy config) — temporary mitigation: force same cert selection across AZs
2) decrease health-check sensitivity to reduce route flapping
3) add cross-region routing guardrail + circuit breaker metrics
4) post-deploy smoke test for SNI/ALPN

eli-choi: I'll take #1. target EOD tomorrow. I'll PR the config; needs review from @todd-barnes.

todd-barnes: ack, can review tomorrow morning. also propose we add a unit test in the infra test harness to simulate mixed certs.

sre-oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1768509123. PagerDuty timeline and notes attached.

katie-prodeng: For #3, can we add a quick rate-limiter at the routing tier to avoid cascading retries? I can prototype.

maria-guzman: assign owners + deadlines so we can track in follow-ups

ajay-singh: action items:
- ajay-singh — do emergency cert roll to normalize SNI selection, due 2026-02-04 17:00 UTC
- eli-choi — PR frontend config & haproxy/nginx change, due 2026-02-05 12:00 UTC
- todd-barnes — review + infra-test, due 2026-02-06 12:00 UTC
- katie-prodeng — prototype routing rate-limiter & run smoke tests, due 2026-02-12
- maria-guzman — coordinate customer comms + SLA check, due 2026-02-07

eli-choi: quick config patch snippet I'm pushing:
```
frontend www-in
  bind :443 ssl crt /etc/certs/global.pem alpn h2,http/1.1
  tcp-request inspect-delay 5s
  tcp-request content accept if { req_ssl_hello_type 1 }
```

ajay-singh: temporary mitigation deployed: pinned cert on 4 frontends — monitoring for 1h. initial tail latency looks ok :eyes: 

todd-barnes: noticed pattern: retries spike ~3-4 minutes after a deploy to eu-west. suggests health-check coupling. adding to recurrence tracker.

maria-guzman: schedule weekly check-ins for 4 weeks to confirm non-recurrence. @sre-oncall-bot set reminder every Monday 09:00 UTC for 4 weeks

sre-oncall-bot: Reminder created: Routing Oscillation follow-up meeting weekly x4.

ajay-singh: marking thread as actionable. will update the postmortem with these owners and close loop once all items are done.

eli-choi: will post PR link shortly.

katie-prodeng: prototype ready, will run against canary tonight and share results tomorrow.

maria-guzman: thanks all. please drop short status updates in this thread when items are complete. :thumbsup:
